name: 2026 Moments
summary: Turn 15 clips into a 27-second 9:16 year-in-review Draft: the year rolls in as a video mask and zooms through the last digit, a Moments title, then white-flash, box-reveal, light-leak and three-strip beat transitions.

compatibility.selects: Uses only the Selects SDK: clip placement, video effects, transitions and motion graphics. Verified on macOS in Selects Staging on 2026-10-07 (saved Draft readback and MP4 export). Windows is unverified.
